name: Matsumoto Ayaka
source:
Affiliation: Wet Prope 2nd Generation
Vehicle: Skeleton Titan 
Guardian Stone: Amethyst

The only pilot from the second graduating class. Intelligent, and particularly skilled in electronic control. Perhaps because she still retains some childishness, she's very clingy.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120402172658/http://www.ideaf.co.jp/skelter/chara.html]official website[/url]]
